scripts.pine:ema-ribbon:
//@version=5
indicator('EMA Ribbon (Stacked + Non-Repainting Buy Signal)', '', true)

// --- Inputs & EMA Calculations ---
int i_length1 = input.int(5, 'Length 1', minval=2)
color i_c_maBull1 = input(color.green, 'Bull 1')
color i_c_maBear1 = input(color.maroon, 'Bear 1')
float ma1 = ta.ema(close, i_length1)

int i_length2 = input.int(8, 'Length 2', minval=2)
color i_c_maBull2 = input(color.green, 'Bull 2')
color i_c_maBear2 = input(color.maroon, 'Bear 2')
float ma2 = ta.ema(close, i_length2)

int i_length3 = input.int(13, 'Length 3', minval=2)
color i_c_maBull3 = input(color.green, 'Bull 3')
color i_c_maBear3 = input(color.maroon, 'Bear 3')
float ma3 = ta.ema(close, i_length3)

int i_length4 = input.int(20, 'Length 4', minval=2)
color i_c_maBull4 = input(color.green, 'Bull 4')
color i_c_maBear4 = input(color.maroon, 'Bear 4')
float ma4 = ta.ema(close, i_length4)

int i_length5 = input.int(50, 'Length 5', minval=2)
color i_c_maBull5 = input(color.green, 'Bull 5')
color i_c_maBear5 = input(color.maroon, 'Bear 5')
float ma5 = ta.ema(close, i_length5)

int i_length6 = input.int(100, 'Length 6', minval=2)
color i_c_maBull6 = input(color.green, 'Bull 6')
color i_c_maBear6 = input(color.maroon, 'Bear 6')
float ma6 = ta.ema(close, i_length6)

int i_length7 = input.int(200, 'Length 7', minval=2)
color i_c_maBull7 = input(color.green, 'Bull 7')
color i_c_maBear7 = input(color.maroon, 'Bear 7')
float ma7 = ta.ema(close, i_length7)

// --- Alignment / Stacking Logic ---
bool ma1_isBull = ma1 > ma2
bool ma2_isBull = ma2 > ma3
bool ma3_isBull = ma3 > ma4
bool ma4_isBull = ma4 > ma5
bool ma5_isBull = ma5 > ma6
bool ma6_isBull = ma6 > ma7
bool ma7_isBull = ma6 > ma7

// --- Plotting EMAs ---
plot(ma1, 'MA 1', ma1_isBull ? i_c_maBull1 : i_c_maBear1, 2)
plot(ma2, 'MA 2', ma2_isBull ? i_c_maBull2 : i_c_maBear2, 2)
plot(ma3, 'MA 3', ma3_isBull ? i_c_maBull3 : i_c_maBear3, 2)
plot(ma4, 'MA 4', ma4_isBull ? i_c_maBull4 : i_c_maBear4, 2)
plot(ma5, 'MA 5', ma5_isBull ? i_c_maBull5 : i_c_maBear5, 2)
plot(ma6, 'MA 6', ma6_isBull ? i_c_maBull6 : i_c_maBear6, 2)
plot(ma7, 'MA 7', ma7_isBull ? i_c_maBull7 : i_c_maBear7, 2)

// --- Non-Repainting Buy Signal Logic ---
// Checks if EMAs 5, 6, and 7 WERE ALL GREEN on the PREVIOUS closed candle [1]
bool emas567_green_prev = ma5_isBull[1] and ma6_isBull[1] and ma7_isBull[1]

// Triggers ONLY on the first candle when the condition becomes true (crosses into condition)
bool buySignal = emas567_green_prev and not (ma5_isBull[2] and ma6_isBull[2] and ma7_isBull[2])

// Plot small green triangle below the current candle bar
plotshape(buySignal, title="Buy Signal", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, size=size.tiny)
scripts.pine:bais-macd-ema:
//@version=6
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  MACD Backgrounds + Period Lines + EMA Backgrounds  (all in 1 indicator)
//
//  Options 1-3 : the chart background follows the MACD histogram colour
//                 of a chosen timeframe:
//                   dark green = hist > 0 & rising
//                   fade  green = hist > 0 & falling
//                   dark red   = hist < 0 & falling
//                   fade  red  = hist < 0 & rising
//                 Every colour is a full colour picker; its transparency
//                 is set inside the picker itself.
//  Options 4-6 : vertical line on the period's starting candle of a
//                 chosen timeframe, anchored with xloc.bar_time, so the
//                 line never moves when the chart timeframe changes.
//  Option 7    : vertical line (+ triangle) on the 1st positive bar of
//                 every MACD run of the chosen timeframe.
//  Options 8-10: background follows the EMA cross state of a chosen
//                 timeframe - EMA 1&2 / EMA 3&4 / EMA 5&6 - each slot
//                 with its own lengths, timeframe, 2 colours and
//                 optional EMA plots.
//
//  All 10      : "Start from 2nd candle" leaves the 1st candle untouched.
//                   · MACD backgrounds (1-3) and EMA backgrounds (8-10):
//                     the period shows the PREVIOUS period's state, so a
//                     new colour only starts on the 2nd candle of the
//                     run. Example with weeks A (red) and B (green): the
//                     background stays red until week C starts, then
//                     turns green; if week C closes red it stays green
//                     until week D starts.
//                   · Period lines (4-6): the line is placed on the 2nd
//                     candle of the period instead of the 1st.
//                   · Marker (7): the line is placed on the 2nd candle
//                     of the run instead of the 1st.
//
//  The MACD itself and the EMAs are calculated INSIDE
//  request.security(), so a "Weekly MACD" is the real weekly MACD (not a
//  daily MACD sampled weekly) and a "Weekly EMA" the real weekly EMA.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
indicator("Abuzar-BAIS Backgrounfof MACD & EMA", shorttitle = "BAIS+MACD+EMA", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500)

string GRP_BGA = "1 · MACD Background A"
string GRP_BGB = "2 · MACD Background B"
string GRP_BGC = "3 · MACD Background C"
string GRP_LNA = "4 · Period Line A"
string GRP_LNB = "5 · Period Line B"
string GRP_LNC = "6 · Period Line C"
string GRP_MK  = "7 · 1st Green MACD Marker"
string GRP_EMA1 = "8 · EMA 1 & 2 Cross"
string GRP_EMA2 = "9 · EMA 3 & 4 Cross"
string GRP_EMA3 = "10 · EMA 5 & 6 Cross"

string TIP_BG = "Background follows the MACD histogram colour of the selected timeframe:\ndark green = above 0 & rising, fade green = above 0 & falling,\ndark red = below 0 & falling, fade red = below 0 & rising."
string TIP_TF = "Timeframe of the MACD. Yearly = 12M (type it in the box if it is not listed)."
string TIP_SK = "Leaves the 1st candle of every period untouched.\nMACD backgrounds: a period shows the PREVIOUS period's histogram colour, so a new colour starts on the period's 2nd candle (week A red, week B green -> background stays red until week C starts, then green).\nLines: the line is placed on the 2nd candle of the period instead of the 1st."
string TIP_LT = "Pick a timeframe HIGHER than the chart's (e.g. Weekly on a Daily chart). Yearly = 12M."
string TIP_MK = "Moves the marker from the run's 1st candle to its 2nd candle (the 2nd chart candle of the period that turned positive)."
string TIP_EON = "Paints the chart background with this EMA pair's cross state: colour 1 while the fast EMA is above the slow EMA, colour 2 while it is below."
string TIP_ET  = "Timeframe the EMAs are calculated on. Yearly = 12M (type it in the box if it is not listed)."
string TIP_ESK = "Leaves the 1st candle of every period untouched: the period shows the PREVIOUS period's cross state, so a new colour only starts on the 2nd candle of the run."
string TIP_LEN = "Length of the EMA (1 = fastest). The two lengths of a pair can be equal or different."
string TIP_PL  = "Draws both EMAs of this pair on the chart (not affected by 'Start from 2nd candle')."

// ═══ 1 · MACD Background A ═════════════════════════════════════════════
bool   bgAOn    = input.bool(false, "Enable", group = GRP_BGA, tooltip = TIP_BG)
string bgATf    = input.timeframe("W", "MACD timeframe", group = GRP_BGA, tooltip = TIP_TF)
color  bgAGrd   = input.color(color.new(#26A69A, 70), "Dark green", inline = "a1", group = GRP_BGA)
color  bgAGrf   = input.color(color.new(#B2DFDB, 70), "Fade green", inline = "a1", group = GRP_BGA)
color  bgARdd   = input.color(color.new(#FF5252, 70), "Dark red", inline = "a2", group = GRP_BGA)
color  bgARdf   = input.color(color.new(#FFCDD2, 70), "Fade red", inline = "a2", group = GRP_BGA)
bool   bgASkip  = input.bool(false, "Start from 2nd candle", group = GRP_BGA, tooltip = TIP_SK)

// ═══ 2 · MACD Background B ═════════════════════════════════════════════
bool   bgBOn    = input.bool(false, "Enable", group = GRP_BGB, tooltip = TIP_BG)
string bgBTf    = input.timeframe("D", "MACD timeframe", group = GRP_BGB, tooltip = TIP_TF)
color  bgBGrd   = input.color(color.new(#26A69A, 70), "Dark green", inline = "b1", group = GRP_BGB)
color  bgBGrf   = input.color(color.new(#B2DFDB, 70), "Fade green", inline = "b1", group = GRP_BGB)
color  bgBRdd   = input.color(color.new(#FF5252, 70), "Dark red", inline = "b2", group = GRP_BGB)
color  bgBRdf   = input.color(color.new(#FFCDD2, 70), "Fade red", inline = "b2", group = GRP_BGB)
bool   bgBSkip  = input.bool(false, "Start from 2nd candle", group = GRP_BGB, tooltip = TIP_SK)

// ═══ 3 · MACD Background C ═════════════════════════════════════════════
bool   bgCOn    = input.bool(false, "Enable", group = GRP_BGC, tooltip = TIP_BG)
string bgCTf    = input.timeframe("M", "MACD timeframe", group = GRP_BGC, tooltip = TIP_TF)
color  bgCGrd   = input.color(color.new(#26A69A, 70), "Dark green", inline = "c1", group = GRP_BGC)
color  bgCGrf   = input.color(color.new(#B2DFDB, 70), "Fade green", inline = "c1", group = GRP_BGC)
color  bgCRdd   = input.color(color.new(#FF5252, 70), "Dark red", inline = "c2", group = GRP_BGC)
color  bgCRdf   = input.color(color.new(#FFCDD2, 70), "Fade red", inline = "c2", group = GRP_BGC)
bool   bgCSkip  = input.bool(false, "Start from 2nd candle", group = GRP_BGC, tooltip = TIP_SK)

// ═══ 4 · Period Line A ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
bool   lnAOn    = input.bool(false, "Enable", group = GRP_LNA)
string lnATf    = input.timeframe("M", "Timeframe", inline = "la", group = GRP_LNA, tooltip = TIP_LT)
color  lnACol   = input.color(#FF9800, "Colour", inline = "la", group = GRP_LNA)
int    lnAW     = input.int(2, "Width", minval = 1, maxval = 5, inline = "lb", group = GRP_LNA)
string lnAStyle = input.string("Solid", "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], inline = "lb", group = GRP_LNA)
bool   lnASkip  = input.bool(false, "Start from 2nd candle", group = GRP_LNA, tooltip = TIP_SK)

// ═══ 5 · Period Line B ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
bool   lnBOn    = input.bool(false, "Enable", group = GRP_LNB)
string lnBTf    = input.timeframe("W", "Timeframe", inline = "lc", group = GRP_LNB, tooltip = TIP_LT)
color  lnBCol   = input.color(#26C6DA, "Colour", inline = "lc", group = GRP_LNB)
int    lnBW     = input.int(2, "Width", minval = 1, maxval = 5, inline = "ld", group = GRP_LNB)
string lnBStyle = input.string("Solid", "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], inline = "ld", group = GRP_LNB)
bool   lnBSkip  = input.bool(false, "Start from 2nd candle", group = GRP_LNB, tooltip = TIP_SK)

// ═══ 6 · Period Line C ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
bool   lnCOn    = input.bool(false, "Enable", group = GRP_LNC)
string lnCTf    = input.timeframe("D", "Timeframe", inline = "le", group = GRP_LNC, tooltip = TIP_LT)
color  lnCCol   = input.color(#AB47BC, "Colour", inline = "le", group = GRP_LNC)
int    lnCW     = input.int(2, "Width", minval = 1, maxval = 5, inline = "lf", group = GRP_LNC)
string lnCStyle = input.string("Solid", "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], inline = "lf", group = GRP_LNC)
bool   lnCSkip  = input.bool(false, "Start from 2nd candle", group = GRP_LNC, tooltip = TIP_SK)

// ═══ 7 · 1st green MACD marker (original feature) ══════════════════════
bool   sigOn    = input.bool(true, "Enable", group = GRP_MK)
string sigTf    = input.timeframe("W", "MACD timeframe", group = GRP_MK, tooltip = "Timeframe of the MACD whose histogram is tested (W = weekly).")
color  sigCol   = input.color(#00E676, "Colour", inline = "s1", group = GRP_MK)
int    sigW     = input.int(2, "Width", minval = 1, maxval = 5, inline = "s1", group = GRP_MK)
string sigStyle = input.string("Solid", "Style", options = ["Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted"], inline = "s2", group = GRP_MK)
bool   sigMark  = input.bool(true, "Show triangle marker", inline = "s2", group = GRP_MK)
bool   sigSkip  = input.bool(false, "Start from 2nd candle", group = GRP_MK, tooltip = TIP_MK)

// ═══ 8 · EMA 1 & 2 cross ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
bool   e1On    = input.bool(false, "Enable background", group = GRP_EMA1, tooltip = TIP_EON)
string e1Tf    = input.timeframe("D", "EMA timeframe", group = GRP_EMA1, tooltip = TIP_ET)
int    e1LenA  = input.int(1, "EMA 1 Length", minval = 1, inline = "eL1", group = GRP_EMA1, tooltip = TIP_LEN)
int    e1LenB  = input.int(2, "EMA 2 Length", minval = 1, inline = "eL1", group = GRP_EMA1, tooltip = TIP_LEN)
color  e1Up    = input.color(color.new(color.green, 88), "Colour: 1 > 2", inline = "eC1", group = GRP_EMA1)
color  e1Dn    = input.color(color.new(color.red, 88), "1 < 2", inline = "eC1", group = GRP_EMA1)
bool   e1Skip  = input.bool(false, "Start from 2nd candle", group = GRP_EMA1, tooltip = TIP_ESK)
bool   e1Plot  = input.bool(true, "Plot EMAs", inline = "eP1", group = GRP_EMA1, tooltip = TIP_PL)
color  e1PA    = input.color(color.green, "Fast", inline = "eP1", group = GRP_EMA1)
color  e1PB    = input.color(color.red, "Slow", inline = "eP1", group = GRP_EMA1)

// ═══ 9 · EMA 3 & 4 cross ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
bool   e2On    = input.bool(false, "Enable background", group = GRP_EMA2, tooltip = TIP_EON)
string e2Tf    = input.timeframe("D", "EMA timeframe", group = GRP_EMA2, tooltip = TIP_ET)
int    e2LenA  = input.int(3, "EMA 3 Length", minval = 1, inline = "eL2", group = GRP_EMA2, tooltip = TIP_LEN)
int    e2LenB  = input.int(4, "EMA 4 Length", minval = 1, inline = "eL2", group = GRP_EMA2, tooltip = TIP_LEN)
color  e2Up    = input.color(color.new(color.green, 88), "Colour: 3 > 4", inline = "eC2", group = GRP_EMA2)
color  e2Dn    = input.color(color.new(color.red, 88), "3 < 4", inline = "eC2", group = GRP_EMA2)
bool   e2Skip  = input.bool(false, "Start from 2nd candle", group = GRP_EMA2, tooltip = TIP_ESK)
bool   e2Plot  = input.bool(true, "Plot EMAs", inline = "eP2", group = GRP_EMA2, tooltip = TIP_PL)
color  e2PA    = input.color(color.green, "Fast", inline = "eP2", group = GRP_EMA2)
color  e2PB    = input.color(color.red, "Slow", inline = "eP2", group = GRP_EMA2)

// ═══ 10 · EMA 5 & 6 cross ══════════════════════════════════════════════
bool   e3On    = input.bool(false, "Enable background", group = GRP_EMA3, tooltip = TIP_EON)
string e3Tf    = input.timeframe("D", "EMA timeframe", group = GRP_EMA3, tooltip = TIP_ET)
int    e3LenA  = input.int(5, "EMA 5 Length", minval = 1, inline = "eL3", group = GRP_EMA3, tooltip = TIP_LEN)
int    e3LenB  = input.int(6, "EMA 6 Length", minval = 1, inline = "eL3", group = GRP_EMA3, tooltip = TIP_LEN)
color  e3Up    = input.color(color.new(color.green, 88), "Colour: 5 > 6", inline = "eC3", group = GRP_EMA3)
color  e3Dn    = input.color(color.new(color.red, 88), "5 < 6", inline = "eC3", group = GRP_EMA3)
bool   e3Skip  = input.bool(false, "Start from 2nd candle", group = GRP_EMA3, tooltip = TIP_ESK)
bool   e3Plot  = input.bool(true, "Plot EMAs", inline = "eP3", group = GRP_EMA3, tooltip = TIP_PL)
color  e3PA    = input.color(color.green, "Fast", inline = "eP3", group = GRP_EMA3)
color  e3PB    = input.color(color.red, "Slow", inline = "eP3", group = GRP_EMA3)

// ═══ helpers ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Source-over blend of two translucent colours (`under` is painted first).
fBlend(color under, color over) =>
    float aU = (100.0 - color.t(under)) / 100.0
    float aO = (100.0 - color.t(over)) / 100.0
    float wU = aU * (1.0 - aO)
    float aR = wU + aO
    float r  = aR <= 0.0 ? 0.0 : (color.r(under) * wU + color.r(over) * aO) / aR
    float g  = aR <= 0.0 ? 0.0 : (color.g(under) * wU + color.g(over) * aO) / aR
    float b  = aR <= 0.0 ? 0.0 : (color.b(under) * wU + color.b(over) * aO) / aR
    color.rgb(r, g, b, 100.0 - aR * 100.0)

// Style name -> line style constant.
fStyle(string s) =>
    s == "Dashed" ? line.style_dashed : s == "Dotted" ? line.style_dotted : line.style_solid

// Opening time of the selected timeframe's period that contains this bar.
fPeriod(string tf) =>
    int t = time(tf)
    na(t) ? time : t

// True on the first chart bar of a new period (also true on the very first bar).
// Never returns `na`, so it is always safe to use in a condition.
fNew(int t, int tPrev) =>
    bar_index == 0 or (not na(t) and not na(tPrev) and t != tPrev)

// Full-height vertical line anchored to an absolute time.
fVLine(int x, color col, string stl, int w) =>
    float y1 = low
    float y2 = high == low ? high + syminfo.mintick : high
    line.new(x, y1, x, y2, xloc = xloc.bar_time, extend = extend.both, color = col, style = stl, width = w)

// MACD histogram state of the timeframe this is requested for.
// 0 = no data yet, 1 = dark green, 2 = fade green, 3 = dark red, 4 = fade red.
// Calculated inside request.security(), so it is the real MACD of that timeframe.
fMacdState() =>
    [macdLine, signalLine, h] = ta.macd(close, 12, 26, 9)
    float st = 0.0
    if not na(h)
        float hp = nz(h[1])
        st := h > 0.0 ? (h > hp ? 1.0 : 2.0) : (h > hp ? 4.0 : 3.0)
    st

// State -> colour of the matching slot (fully transparent when unknown).
fPick(float st, color c1, color c2, color c3, color c4) =>
    float s = nz(st, 0.0)
    s == 1.0 ? c1 : s == 2.0 ? c2 : s == 3.0 ? c3 : s == 4.0 ? c4 : color.new(color.white, 100)

// Fully transparent colour (slot off / state unknown).
color invisible = color.new(color.white, 100)

// ═══ 1/2/3 · MACD backgrounds ══════════════════════════════════════════
// lookahead_on = the colour of a period is shown from that period's 1st
// candle, exactly like the MACD pane shows it for historical bars.
stA = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, bgATf, fMacdState(), lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
stB = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, bgBTf, fMacdState(), lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
stC = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, bgCTf, fMacdState(), lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

// "Start from 2nd candle": latch the previous period's state on the 1st
// candle of each period, so the colour shown during week N is week N-1's
// histogram colour. A new colour therefore only starts on the 2nd candle
// of the run: A red, B green -> red until C starts, then green; if C
// closes red it stays green until D starts.
paBg  = fPeriod(bgATf)
paNew = fNew(paBg, paBg[1])
var float stAd = 0.0
if paNew and bar_index > 0
    stAd := stA[1]

pbBg  = fPeriod(bgBTf)
pbNew = fNew(pbBg, pbBg[1])
var float stBd = 0.0
if pbNew and bar_index > 0
    stBd := stB[1]

pcBg  = fPeriod(bgCTf)
pcNew = fNew(pcBg, pcBg[1])
var float stCd = 0.0
if pcNew and bar_index > 0
    stCd := stC[1]

color slotA = bgAOn ? fPick(bgASkip ? stAd : stA, bgAGrd, bgAGrf, bgARdd, bgARdf) : invisible
color slotB = bgBOn ? fPick(bgBSkip ? stBd : stB, bgBGrd, bgBGrf, bgBRdd, bgBRdf) : invisible
color slotC = bgCOn ? fPick(bgCSkip ? stCd : stC, bgCGrd, bgCGrf, bgCRdd, bgCRdf) : invisible

// ═══ 7 · 1st positive bar of every MACD run ════════════════════════════
// State and period open time come from the SAME snapshot, so the line always
// lands on the first candle of the period that turned positive.
// lookahead_off = only completed periods are used, so the marker never repaints.
[stMk, tMk] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, sigTf, [fMacdState(), time], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_off)

// "Start from 2nd candle": keep the open time and the 2nd-chart-candle time
// of the current period AND of the one before it. Depending on when the
// requested value becomes visible (on the period's end candle, on the next
// period's 1st candle, or already on the period's own 1st candle) the period
// that turned positive is either the current one or the previous one, so
// both are remembered instead of relying on a single guess.
mkPer  = fPeriod(sigTf)
mkNew  = fNew(mkPer, mkPer[1])
var int  mkOpenCur  = 0
var int  mkOpenPrev = 0
var int  mkT2Cur    = 0
var int  mkT2Prev   = 0
var bool mkWasNew   = false
if mkNew
    mkOpenPrev := mkOpenCur
    mkOpenCur  := mkPer
    mkT2Prev   := mkT2Cur
    mkT2Cur    := 0
else if mkWasNew
    mkT2Cur := time
mkWasNew := mkNew

float sm  = nz(stMk, -1.0)
float sm1 = nz(stMk[1], 4.0)
sigHit = sigOn and barstate.isconfirmed and sm >= 1.0 and sm <= 2.0 and sm1 >= 3.0

// Where the marker goes with "Start from 2nd candle" switched on.
int  mkWant  = tMk
bool mkLater = false
if sigSkip and not na(tMk)
    if tMk == mkOpenCur and mkT2Cur != 0
        mkWant := mkT2Cur
    else if tMk == mkOpenPrev and mkT2Prev != 0
        mkWant := mkT2Prev
    else if tMk == mkOpenCur
        mkLater := true

var bool mkPend  = false
var int  mkPendX = 0

// The run is still going -> the next bar IS the run's 2nd candle. A run of
// a single candle has no 2nd one, so it falls back to the run's 1st candle.
int mkDrawX = sigOn and sm >= 1.0 and sm <= 2.0 ? time : mkPendX

// Drawing postponed by one bar (the 2nd candle did not exist yet above).
if mkPend
    mkPend := false
    fVLine(mkDrawX, sigCol, fStyle(sigStyle), sigW)
    if sigMark
        label.new(mkDrawX, na, "", xloc = xloc.bar_time, yloc = yloc.abovebar, style = label.style_triangleup, color = sigCol, size = size.small)

var int sigLastBar = -1
if sigHit and bar_index != sigLastBar
    sigLastBar := bar_index
    if mkLater
        mkPend  := true
        mkPendX := tMk
    else
        fVLine(mkWant, sigCol, fStyle(sigStyle), sigW)
        if sigMark
            label.new(mkWant, na, "", xloc = xloc.bar_time, yloc = yloc.abovebar, style = label.style_triangleup, color = sigCol, size = size.small)

alertcondition(sigHit, title = "1st green MACD bar", message = "MACD histogram turned positive on {{ticker}}, {{interval}}")

// ═══ 4/5/6 · Period start lines ════════════════════════════════════════
la    = fPeriod(lnATf)
laNew = fNew(la, la[1])
var int laStart = -1
if laNew
    laStart := bar_index
laHit = lnASkip ? bar_index == laStart + 1 : laNew
var int laLast = -1
if lnAOn and laHit and bar_index != laLast
    fVLine(time, lnACol, fStyle(lnAStyle), lnAW)
    laLast := bar_index

lb    = fPeriod(lnBTf)
lbNew = fNew(lb, lb[1])
var int lbStart = -1
if lbNew
    lbStart := bar_index
lbHit = lnBSkip ? bar_index == lbStart + 1 : lbNew
var int lbLast = -1
if lnBOn and lbHit and bar_index != lbLast
    fVLine(time, lnBCol, fStyle(lnBStyle), lnBW)
    lbLast := bar_index

lc    = fPeriod(lnCTf)
lcNew = fNew(lc, lc[1])
var int lcStart = -1
if lcNew
    lcStart := bar_index
lcHit = lnCSkip ? bar_index == lcStart + 1 : lcNew
var int lcLast = -1
if lnCOn and lcHit and bar_index != lcLast
    fVLine(time, lnCCol, fStyle(lnCStyle), lnCW)
    lcLast := bar_index

// ═══ 8/9/10 · EMA cross backgrounds ════════════════════════════════════
// The EMAs are calculated INSIDE request.security() (the real EMA of that
// timeframe). lookahead_on = a period's value is visible from that
// period's 1st candle, so the switch lands exactly on the boundary.
ema1 = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, e1Tf, ta.ema(close, e1LenA), lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
ema2 = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, e1Tf, ta.ema(close, e1LenB), lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

st1 = (not na(ema1) and not na(ema2)) ? (ema1 > ema2 ? 1.0 : (ema1 < ema2 ? -1.0 : 0.0)) : 0.0

per1 = fPeriod(e1Tf)
new1 = fNew(per1, per1[1])
var float st1L = 0.0
if new1 and bar_index > 0
    st1L := st1[1]

float use1 = e1Skip ? st1L : st1
color  bg1  = e1On ? (use1 == 1.0 ? e1Up : use1 == -1.0 ? e1Dn : invisible) : invisible

ema3 = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, e2Tf, ta.ema(close, e2LenA), lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
ema4 = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, e2Tf, ta.ema(close, e2LenB), lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

st2 = (not na(ema3) and not na(ema4)) ? (ema3 > ema4 ? 1.0 : (ema3 < ema4 ? -1.0 : 0.0)) : 0.0

per2 = fPeriod(e2Tf)
new2 = fNew(per2, per2[1])
var float st2L = 0.0
if new2 and bar_index > 0
    st2L := st2[1]

float use2 = e2Skip ? st2L : st2
color  bg2  = e2On ? (use2 == 1.0 ? e2Up : use2 == -1.0 ? e2Dn : invisible) : invisible

ema5 = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, e3Tf, ta.ema(close, e3LenA), lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
ema6 = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, e3Tf, ta.ema(close, e3LenB), lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

st3 = (not na(ema5) and not na(ema6)) ? (ema5 > ema6 ? 1.0 : (ema5 < ema6 ? -1.0 : 0.0)) : 0.0

per3 = fPeriod(e3Tf)
new3 = fNew(per3, per3[1])
var float st3L = 0.0
if new3 and bar_index > 0
    st3L := st3[1]

float use3 = e3Skip ? st3L : st3
color  bg3  = e3On ? (use3 == 1.0 ? e3Up : use3 == -1.0 ? e3Dn : invisible) : invisible

// ═══ background · MACD slots (1-3) + EMA slots (8-10), one call ════════
// The two groups are alpha-blended together, so a slot only shows through
// the ones painted above it and nothing hides the others completely.
color bgEma  = fBlend(fBlend(bg1, bg2), bg3)
color bgMacd = fBlend(fBlend(slotA, slotB), slotC)
bgcolor(fBlend(bgEma, bgMacd), title = "Background")

// ═══ EMA plots (8/9/10) ════════════════════════════════════════════════
plot(e1Plot ? ema1 : na, title = "EMA 1", color = e1PA, linewidth = 2)
plot(e1Plot ? ema2 : na, title = "EMA 2", color = e1PB, linewidth = 2)
plot(e2Plot ? ema3 : na, title = "EMA 3", color = e2PA, linewidth = 2)
plot(e2Plot ? ema4 : na, title = "EMA 4", color = e2PB, linewidth = 2)
plot(e3Plot ? ema5 : na, title = "EMA 5", color = e3PA, linewidth = 2)
plot(e3Plot ? ema6 : na, title = "EMA 6", color = e3PB, linewidth = 2)
